comentarios: Visit to Puerto Inírida with Pablo Florez, Guilherme Brito and John Lobel to study this Thamnophilus, discovered at Inírida by PF in August 2016, and here provisionally assigned to T. palliatus, in recognition of its apparently closer morphological similarity to the latter, rather than to T. tenuepunctatus. This is one of a series of recordings of a male, different to that in XC499361, which inhabited a recently cleared chacra, still with a good number of Cecropia and bushy growth at its edges. For more information about these birds see: Florez, P. (2017) A mysterious antshrike in eastern Colombia. Neotrop. Birding 20: 21-24.
